dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Nam, I have one week in Thailand. Which region should I visit?
dialogue.reading: ˈnɑːm, aɪ ˈhæv ˈwʌn ˈwiːk ɪn ˈtaɪlænd. ˈwɪtʃ ˈriːdʒən ʃʊd aɪ ˈvɪzɪt?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: What do you like more: mountains, food or beaches?
dialogue.reading: ˈwʌt duː juː ˈlaɪk ˈmɔːr: ˈmaʊntənz, ˈfuːd ɔːr ˈbiːtʃɪz?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Then go to northern Thailand. Chiang Mai, which is the biggest city there, has mountains, forests and old temples.
dialogue.reading: ˈðɛn ˈɡoʊ tə ˈnɔːrðərn ˈtaɪlænd. ˈtʃjɑːŋ ˈmaɪ, wɪtʃ ɪz ðə ˈbɪɡɪst ˈsɪti ðɛr, ˈhæz ˈmaʊntənz, ˈfɔːrɪsts ənd ˈoʊld ˈtɛmpəlz.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Sounds great. And what about food?
dialogue.reading: ˈsaʊndz ˈɡreɪt. ənd ˈwʌt əˈbaʊt ˈfuːd?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: The northeastern region, which we call Isan, has amazing food. It's very spicy!
dialogue.reading: ðə ˌnɔːrθˈiːstərn ˈriːdʒən, wɪtʃ wiː ˈkɔːl iˈsɑːn, ˈhæz əˈmeɪzɪŋ ˈfuːd. ɪts ˈvɛri ˈspaɪsi!

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: No. Bangkok, which is the capital, is in the central region.
dialogue.reading: ˈnoʊ. ˈbæŋkɑːk, wɪtʃ ɪz ðə ˈkæpɪtəl, ɪz ɪn ðə ˈsɛntrəl ˈriːdʒən.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Go to the southern provinces. Krabi, which has beautiful islands, is my favorite.
dialogue.reading: ˈɡoʊ tə ðə ˈsʌðərn ˈprɑːvɪnsɪz. ˈkrɑːbi, wɪtʃ ˈhæz ˈbjuːtəfəl ˈaɪləndz, ɪz maɪ ˈfeɪvərɪt.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Thanks, Nam! Maybe I'll fly to Krabi after Chiang Mai.
dialogue.reading: ˈθæŋks, ˈnɑːm! ˈmeɪbi aɪl ˈflaɪ tə ˈkrɑːbi ˈæftər ˈtʃjɑːŋ ˈmaɪ.
